value.deck: A popular AI helper for writing code can now remember your past work and run privately on your own computer.
shortVersion: AI assistants help people write computer programs much like a smart assistant helps draft documents. A popular coding helper called GitHub Copilot can now remember details across different working sessions. This means it will not forget your project details when you start working again later.

The tool also now connects with a system called Ollama. This lets creators run AI programs directly on their own personal computer rather than sending information over the internet. It offers a safer option for people who want to keep their private work confidential.
value.plainLanguage: GitHub Copilot can now remember previous work on big projects and run AI models privately on your own computer.

keyTerms.meaning: An AI helper designed to assist people with writing software code.
A feature that lets an AI remember context and details from past working sessions.
An AI program that runs entirely on your own device instead of over the internet.

value.whyItMatters: This change makes AI tools much more helpful over long projects because you do not have to start from scratch each time, while also giving privacy-focused users a way to keep their data safe on their own devices.
watchNext: Watch to see if other AI helpers start adding memory features for long projects.
Look out for more tools that let you run AI models directly on your own computer.
